zh-Hans: 新增 App 内更新：后台下载，正常退出时安装，不打断当前任务。
改进口语整理、改口与分段，支持按应用设置，未设置时默认速度优先。
自动检查与下载可分别关闭，并保留已有设置。
en: In-app updates download in the background and install on Quit without interrupting your work.
Improved speech cleanup, self-corrections and paragraphs, with per-app settings and speed as the default preference.
Automatic update checks and downloads have separate controls and preserve your settings.
